title: Claude新模型曝光：跳出思维定势，修Bug"治本"而非"治标"
summary: Anthropic 新版 Claude 近日曝光，内测用户称其能跳出常见思维定势——当用户要求修复单一 Bug 时，模型会主动识别根本类问题并询问是否一并处理，而非只打补丁；股票投资建议也不再是老套的市盈率建议，而是提出创新性预测算法。
summary_en: Anthropic's new Claude model has leaked via internal testing, showing it can跳出思维定势 — when asked to fix a single bug, it identifies root cause classes and asks whether to fix them all together rather than just patching. For investment advice, it proposes creative prediction algorithms instead of clichéd P/E ratio suggestions. Gemini 4 Carbon also surfaced, with a Google employee hinting the new model may use RSI (Recursive Self-Improvement). GPT-6.1 Terra appeared in Microsoft Copilot code, with OpenAI planning to merge Chat/Work and Codex modes.
body:
Anthropic 新版 Claude 近日曝光，内测用户称其能跳出常见思维定势——当用户要求修复单一 Bug 时，模型会主动识别根本类问题并询问是否一并处理，而非只打补丁；股票投资建议也不再是老套的市盈率建议，而是提出创新性预测算法。
